money_core.interpretation: Upstream 3-12M liquidity/money regime signal. Leading means empirically forward-oriented relative to the other GMLI layers; it is not a structural-causality claim.

basis.promoted_fixed_transmission_gate: 6/6 relationships retained under Money V2 transfer without retuning
basis.DBC_granger_excluded: USD Money level failed the fixed 5% ADF stationarity check (p=0.098466), so its Granger p-values are descriptive only.

money_core.guardrail: Do not interpret LEADING as proof of structural causality or as uniform short-horizon timing across every promoted asset.

funding_v2.interpretation: Current financial-conditions/friction overlay. Equity/volatility stress tends to precede changes in Funding; Funding is more useful for confirming how restrictive/supportive conditions are than as an independent equity-leading forecast.

basis.interpretation_of_controls: VIX absorbs most incremental SPY information, consistent with a shared financial-stress channel.

funding_v2.guardrail: Funding remains a promoted bounded OVERLAY. Existing DBC 6M/12M usefulness is an association, not upgraded to a causal claim.

fiscal_v2.interpretation: Fiscal has a positive fixed SPY 12M usefulness relationship but weak/regime-dependent temporal precedence and some reverse market-to-Fiscal evidence. Treat primarily as policy/confirmation context, not a clean leading factor.
fiscal_v2.guardrail: Fiscal automatic global conviction weight remains 0.

market_confirmation.interpretation: Completed-month price turn is confirmation by construction; it validates or conflicts with the upstream Money regime rather than creating the macro regime.

funding_market_confirmation_overlap.interpretation: Funding and market confirmation are both reactive but are not the same state variable. Funding is dominated by financial-conditions/volatility channels; market confirmation is cross-asset price-trend confirmation. The overlap diagnostic does not justify changing the frozen 10-point rubric.

practical_hierarchy: Money Core [LEADING] sets the baseline 3-12M regime.
Asset Transmission maps that upstream Money signal to the few promoted asset relationships.
Funding V2 [REACTIVE_CONFIRMATION] describes current financial friction and adjusts confidence, not the baseline regime.
Fiscal V2 [MIXED] supplies policy/fiscal context with zero automatic weight.
Market Confirmation [REACTIVE_CONFIRMATION] validates or contradicts the macro thesis using completed-month price action.
production_guardrail: No score, threshold, promoted relationship, evidence tier or 10-point conviction weight changed. Any future de-duplication or role-based weighting requires a separately frozen versioned decision-engine candidate.
